data.text:
# JS Spring Cursor
A JavaScript node runs a chain of springs (a tentacle) that chases the mouse; a GLSL node draws it as one smooth, glossy SDF ribbon with a soft shadow.
Move the mouse over the preview. Leave it still for 2 s and the head wanders on its own.
## What the JS does
- Setup (runs once): Float32Arrays in state for 48 positions and velocities.
- Every frame: the head eases toward the mouse with damp(current, target, rate), an exponential smoothing that is the same at any frame rate.
- The rest of the chain is masses and springs (Hooke force + damping of the relative velocity, gravity, a little air drag, a travelling sideways wave), integrated with semi-implicit Euler in fixed 1/240 s sub-steps: stiff springs stay stable, and 30, 60 or 144 fps all move the same.
- Outputs: chain = dataTexture(out, 48, 1, 4) with (x, y, radius, t) per mass, count, and head (a vec2 output, used for the light pool).
## Make it yours
Double-click the JS node (Spring Chain group): add a second chain, pin the tail, change the forces. In Spring Ribbon (Render group) change the colours, the bands or the profile: it is a 2D SDF, so outlines, glows or a 3D-looking tube are a few lines each.
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P: Physics and Look settings; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Spring Chain (JS)
Reads params['Segments'], ['Length'], ['Stiffness'], ['Damping'], ['Gravity'], ['Follow'], ['Wiggle'], ['Thickness'], ['Taper'] by label, plus mouse, dt and time.
Stiffness is scaled by the segment count (shorter springs are stiffer), damping acts on the relative velocity along each spring; sub-steps of 1/240 s keep everything stable up to 48 segments at Stiffness 600.

## Render
Spring Ribbon: smooth union of tapered capsules → distance d; normal from the SDF gradient plus a round tube profile; diffuse + specular (Gloss) + Fresnel rim, colour from Colour A (head) to Colour B (tip) with ring bands; drop shadow = the same SDF shifted away from the light. Vignette and grain finish it.

data.label: Segments
data.description: Number of masses in the chain.

data.label: Length
data.description: Rest length of the whole chain (screen heights).

data.label: Stiffness
data.description: Spring stiffness: low = stretchy and bouncy, high = tight.

data.label: Damping
data.description: Damps the springs: 0 = jelly that keeps wobbling.

data.label: Follow
data.description: How fast the head catches up with the mouse (damp rate, per second).

data.label: Wiggle
data.description: A travelling sideways wave that makes it swim.

data.label: Taper
data.description: How thin the tip gets (1 = a point).
